title: Editorial policy
headline: Useful guidance, without invented certainty.
description: The blog explains preparation questions and links to relevant official sources.

sections.title: Source references
sections.text: Official links are provided so readers can check the current requirements. They do not indicate a partnership, appointment or endorsement of this business.

sections.title: Dates and authors
sections.text: Article dates identify publication and content updates. They are not claims of professional review or a guarantee that all external rules were verified on that date. Named reviewers are listed only when their role and review are confirmed.

sections.title: No unsupported claims
sections.text: We avoid invented customer totals, satisfaction rates, fixed official charges and blanket processing times. Programme scope and acceptance must be confirmed for the actual case.

sections.title: Corrections
sections.text: Email the page link and a description of the issue to info@salaroutsourcing.com. Do not attach private documents merely to report a content error.
